channel.title: Field notes on AI agent adoption · Vishal Kumar Sarvade
channel.description: One short note a day on how companies are putting AI agents to work, with every source linked.

item.title: Agent governance: confidence is high, controls are not
item.description: A new survey of 858 executives finds 82% believe they can govern AI agents. Only 5% have automated controls, audit trails and human review points in place.
